what: open_experiments #48: does FastH3's backbone diff add anything to fl2va plus its gates, and does depth matter. MiniMaxH3OverlayLoader on fasth3_v2_on_fl2va.h3overlay.safetensors with the gates on and refiner, adaln and io off, blocks empty (gates_only), '30-49' (late_30_49) and '0-29' (early_0_29), on FastH3's contract harness, seed 730451892, three scenes each at its written length. Graphs: bench/make_overlay_loader_graphs.py --out-dir internal/overlay_graphs (scratch, gitignored). FastH3 as released, per scene, is overlay_all in bench/fasth3_gate_dial_arms.json and 2026-09-29_overlay_loader_render.jsonl; it is not re-rendered here.
why: #35 (2026-09-29_fasth3_gates.md) put FastH3's look in its gates. The only structure left in the backbone change is at the ends, and FastH3 and FlashGen agree in blocks 30-49 (2026-09-26_fasth3_weights.md finding 5; 2026-09-29_fasth3_bf16_rank.md). This asks whether any of it shows once the gates are on. HELD: the owner put the FastH3 mutant on hold on 2026-09-29; this manifest is written and not run.

predictions.P1: late_30_49 looks like gates_only: the same convergence, tone and fine-detail level on all three scenes, within the run-to-run floor on the measures #35 used. A hunch: #35 found the backbone change is not what carries the look.
predictions.P2: early_0_29 looks like gates_only too, and is closer to it than late_30_49 is. A weaker hunch, resting only on the bf16 rank record (the middle blocks sit near a noise control).
predictions.falsifier: if late_30_49 reaches FastH3's own numbers (overlay_all) on hf where gates_only does not, on all three scenes, the late backbone carries part of the look and the shippable piece is not the gates alone. If early_0_29 does that instead, location is not what the weight-agreement finding suggested.
